preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n must be between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The permutation must contain exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
The permutation must contain all integers from 1 to n exactly once (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any((a / b) in permutation for a in permutation for b in permutation if a != b and 1 <= a / b <= n) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a pair of distinct integers a and b in the permutation such that the value of a divided by b (using floating-point division) is also present in the permutation. Otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
